component.name: Acreage
component.summary: See what's taking up your disk

description.p: Acreage shows your disk as a map: every folder and file is a block, labelled and sized by the space it takes. It fills in while it scans and keeps up when files change, so you can watch a download grow or see a cleanup land.
Sizes match du: hardlinks are counted once, btrfs subvolumes of the same filesystem are included, and sparse or compressed files are flagged.

ul.li: Filters like *.iso;>1gb that combine names, sizes, age and tags
Tags, several views at once, and rescanning just one folder
Move to Trash after a confirm step
Reports in text, CSV or JSON, and a command-line report mode
Works from the keyboard and tiles cleanly in i3 and Sway

description.p: No account and no telemetry: nothing leaves your machine.
